description:
Generate Go code from an OpenAPI spec with `mockzilla generate`, which is mockzilla-codegen built into the CLI: models by default, and a server, a client or MCP tools when asked. Use it when the user wants typed Go code for an API in their own project: models for a spec, a server to implement, or a client to call it. It is not for mocking: to serve a mock use `serve_locally`, and a mockzilla codegen-mode project is built by its own action.

Runs in `dir`, where relative paths resolve and where `codegen.yaml` is read when it exists. Without a config and without flags it writes models only, to `./gen.go`. Flags win over the config. For anything past the flags (output files per part, naming, validation, templates) write a codegen.yaml first: read the `codegen/` docs, `codegen/config` lists every key.

Modes: `write` (default) writes the files; `dry_run` lists the files and parts it would write and writes nothing; `check` writes nothing and reports generated files that are missing or out of date. Reports errors and warnings found in the spec. A part that cannot be generated is left out with a warning, the rest is written. Writes Go files into the user's project in write mode, overwriting generated files from an earlier run; scaffold files are written once and then left alone.

client.description: true generates a client, false leaves out one the config asks for.

config.description: Config file, relative to dir. Defaults to codegen.yaml in dir when it exists. Paths inside it are relative to the config file.

dir.description: Absolute path of the folder to run in, usually the Go module or package the code belongs to.

mcp.description: true generates MCP tools over the client (so it needs a client too), false leaves them out.

output.description: Output file, relative to dir. Replaces output.file.

package.description: Go package name. Defaults to the output folder's name.

server.description: Router framework for a server: beego, chi, echo, echo-v5, fasthttp, fiber, gin, go-zero, goframe, gorilla-mux, hertz, iris, kratos or std-http (net/http's ServeMux). false leaves out a server the config asks for.

spec.description: Spec file (relative to dir) or URL. Replaces spec.path of the config. Needed when there is no codegen.yaml.

strict.description: Fail on a warning too, not only on an error.

name: generate
